text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for the present. This 
watering can looks very easy to use.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It's not much. Use it if you can.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Still, that I've been growing plants— I 
never expected you to know about that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well... I mean, who wouldn't be curious? 
You were watering them with such a 
gigantic watering can.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it hasn't really been 
pruned, either. Even if you don't want to 
make it smaller, at least trim it into 
shape.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Also, it's good to mist the leaves once in 
a while to clean them. It's bad if dust 
starts accumulating on them.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. It's just that I'm happy you're 
paying such close attention to the fine 
details.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I just got a little curious, that's 
all. Trees... are better off healthy, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is true. Thank you for the 
advice. I shall put it into practice 
starting today. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(............The way she gives me advice 
like this, it kinda reminds me of 
Groove-nee.)
